verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents workflow automation ("Trigger workflow... to notify, update, or validate information"), Blueprints, and Bank Rules that can act automatically, plus MCP-driven agent actions for invoicing/reporting, but none of the evidence describes an explicit scheduler, cron-like recurring job, or AI-native mechanism to schedule workflows on a timed cadence. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/scheduled workflow documentation, AI-agent-triggered scheduling API, and independent confirmation that MCP or workflow triggers support time-based recurrence rather than event-based triggers only.
